correctness.rationale: The base 315 subset-sum set is derived exactly; the integer-shift interval covering lemma holds for all 1<=t<=103 and has an explicit gap at all t>=104. Separate explicit missing-sum obstructions exclude all squarefree four-support, p>=17 in the other layers, and 105*13^2. Each of the five exceptional positive cases has a complete 21-step two-hole induction certificate, checked from exact divisor lists; finite computation is not used as a substitute for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete finite classification of the natural first feasible Omega=5 layer at four prime support; its nontrivial sharp uniform cutoff of 103 for a prime multiplier is strengthened to all positive integer multipliers by a reusable explicit two-block interval lemma. It distinguishes the behavior of extending non-almost-practical 315 from established closure for almost practical bases.
